purpose: Record high-generative-potential historical material and questions for independent operators. These are not new theory claims or novelty verdicts.
evidence_policy: Every old proposition is copied from its frozen source. Citation lines refer to baseline paths at baseline_commit. Canonical rejection means excluded as center, not asserted false; local note seeds have no invented rejection. Family leads are not complete-proposition kills.
selection_policy: Prioritize institutional interactions, positive assistance branches, relationship composition, norm adjustment, culture, succession, and welfare uncertainty. Do not make provider power the default anchor.

seeds.name: Apprenticeship bottleneck
seeds.old_proposition: Automating junior tasks can reduce production of future experts needed for exceptional cases.

historical_rejection.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.
historical_rejection.scope: Rejected as intellectual center, not asserted false.

seeds.old_distinguishing_test: Compare expert supply under alternative training pipelines.
potential_compositional_questions: Which paid case exposures disappear when firms automate junior work, and which still produce independent judgment?
How do pooled training, protected practice, and agent-supported substantive cases compare when firms share a future expert pool?
